scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pribe/server" "npm run dev -w @pribe/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @pribe/web && npm run build -w @pribe/server
